notes.subject: כמתלהמים
notes.rationale: Famous crux: read as 'dainty morsels' (from להם 'swallow greedily', ASV/JPS) or repointed כמהלמות 'like blows/wounds' (KJV); Bambara follows the morsels reading with the swallowing picture.

notes.subject: מתלהמים
notes.rationale: This verb form occurs only here in the Tanakh.

notes.subject: ירדו חדרי בטן
notes.rationale: 'Go down into the chambers of the belly' plays swallowed food against swallowed gossip; the picture kept in 'don kɔnɔ bonw kɔnɔ'.

translation: Ninkisirilan kumaw i n'a fɔ dumuni fitinw minnu ka di dun, kolu bɛ don kɔnɔ bonw kɔnɔ.

tokens.gloss: i n'a fɔ dumuni fitinw minnu ka di dun
